title: Skill Riposte
wikitext:
Riposte is a native skill to seize the opportunity of an opening. With this ability, every time you are hit and riposte, you get one free attack. Only works on attacks in front of you.

Generates Swing Agro [https://project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=412540]
